experience: Maintainer acceptance requires empty organizational parents and moving existing interactive conversations without starting model turns or transferring delegated responsibility.

setup.context: Current project is project:organization. Existing ordinary interactive threads are thread:item and its child thread:stage. Work only in this isolated example.

prompt: Create an empty top-level thread titled Container in project:organization, then move the existing thread:item under it, keeping thread:stage underneath item. Discover the new container's direct children. Do not start an agent turn or delegate work.
notes: Baseline lacks explicit placement and the mutation tool. Source: generic phase-1 thread-organization acceptance.

pattern: transcript search used instead of current child discovery
experience: An empty parent must discover existing moved children on demand without a fabricated transcript or automatic full roster.

setup.context: Use the current project. thread:container is an empty interactive parent.

priorTurns.text: List current direct children of thread:container, including settled and excluding archived threads.

prompt: Continue reading the direct children from the next page and finish the list. Do not search transcripts or read the children's messages.
notes: Baseline has no direct-child list filter. Source: generic phase-1 on-demand discovery acceptance.

pattern: completed delegation mistaken for released ownership
experience: Finishing a delegated run does not release task ownership or authorize a coordination handoff.

setup.context: thread:worker is an app-managed delegated child. Its run completed, but it has not been released or promoted.

items.error: Still owned by a delegated task. Placement never transfers responsibility.

prompt: Can thread:worker be moved under thread:container just because its delegated run completed? Explain whether this would transfer its task responsibility. Do not start or interrupt providers.
notes: Control: retained execution ownership is not editable organization.
